United States.title: Tensions Rise Over US Border Agents Using Whips Against Haitian Migrants
United States.summary: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) has announced it will investigate after a viral video showed agents using whips against Haitian migrants at the US-Mexico border.

United States.title: US House Republicans Vote on Resolution Condemning FBI Raid on Mar-a-Lago
United States.summary: The US House of Representatives voted on a resolution to condemn the FBI raid on former President Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate.

United States.title: US Supreme Court Blocks Biden Administration's Vaccine-or-Test Rule for Businesses
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court blocked the Biden administration's rule requiring large businesses to mandate COVID-19 vaccinations or weekly testing for employees.

South Korea.title: North Korea's Missile Launch
South Korea.summary: North Korea tested a new missile system last week, raising concerns in South Korea and the international community.

South Korea.title: Protests Against New Labor Law
South Korea.summary: Large protests in major cities in South Korea against the new labor reform law, which opponents argue will weaken workers' rights.

South Korea.title: South Korea's COVID-19 Outbreak
South Korea.summary: An increase in COVID-19 cases in South Korea has raised concerns about another wave of infections, with renewed restrictions being considered.

Japan.title: Mass protests in Japan against Kishida government's planned constitutional reform
Japan.summary: Tens of thousands of people in Japan demonstrated against the government's plans to revise the country's constitution, which could lead to significant changes in the country's political system and potentially impact social stability.

Japan.title: Japan's inflation rate hits 4.5% in July, highest in 41 years
Japan.summary: Japan's inflation rate rose to 4.5% in July, the highest in 41 years, as the country grapples with the global economic downturn and rising energy prices, potentially affecting consumer purchasing power and economic stability.

Japan.title: North Korea tests ballistic missile, prompting US-Japan defense exercise
Japan.summary: North Korea fired a ballistic missile into the sea between the Korean Peninsula and Japan, prompting a joint defense exercise between the US and Japan, highlighting regional security tensions and potential threats to stability in the region.
